sections.preamble: You are an expert coding assistant operating inside pi, a coding agent harness. You help users by reading files, executing commands, editing code, and writing new files.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: mcp__blender__get_python_api_docs
toolsAdded.description:
Return the Blender Python API docs for *identifier*, or list
modules matching a trailing-``*`` discovery pattern.

*identifier* should be a fully-qualified Python name (e.g.
``bpy.app`` or ``bpy.types.Scene.frame_current``).
The trailing-``*`` forms are supported as discovery entry-points:

- ``*`` enumerates the top-level modules (``bpy``, ``bmesh``,
  ``mathutils``, ``gpu``, ...).
- ``X.*`` enumerates the direct-child identifiers under the
  *X* namespace (``bpy.*`` -> ``bpy.app``, ``bpy.context``, ...).

Both return a ``namespace`` response even when ``X.rst`` would
otherwise resolve to ``exact``; the ``.*`` form lets an agent
force the child listing.

The response always carries ``kind``, ``found``, and ``identifier``.
The remaining keys depend on ``kind``:

- ``"exact"`` (``found=True``): ``<identifier>.rst`` was read.
  Extra keys: ``content`` (RST text), ``examples``. When the
  file exceeds 32 KB, ``content`` is replaced with a dot-point
  summary of the file's top-level definitions (prefixed by a
  header noting the truncation) and ``examples`` is empty -
  re-query individual members for their rendered blocks.
- ``"namespace"`` (``found=True``):
  no ``<identifier>.rst`` but ``<identifier>.<child>.rst`` siblings exist.
  Extra key: ``submodules`` (list of child identifiers).
- ``"definition"`` (``found=True``):
  *identifier* is defined inside a parent RST
  (e.g. ``bpy.props.IntProperty`` lives in ``bpy.props.rst``).
  Extra keys: ``content`` (rendered block), ``examples``.
- ``"partial"`` (``found=False``):
  the parent RST was located but the trailing component isn't defined in it.
  Extra keys:
  - ``parent`` the identifier whose RST was loaded.
  - ``available`` top-level definitions in that RST.
  - ``submodules`` sibling identifiers ``<parent>.<child>`` with their own RSTs,
    filtered to those whose last component contains every character of the missing tail.

  For a toctree landing page like ``bpy.types`` ``available`` is empty and ``submodules``
  is the near-miss list; for a self-contained module like ``bpy.props`` it's the reverse.
- ``"suggestions"`` (``found=False``):
  no direct match, but *identifier* appears as a component of other files.
  Extra key: ``suggestions`` (list of full identifiers).
- ``"missing"`` (``found=False``): nothing matched.

``examples`` (present on the ``exact`` and ``definition`` kinds)
is a list of ``{path, content}`` entries referenced from this documentation.

toolsAdded.name: mcp__blender__search_api_docs
toolsAdded.description:
Full-text search over the bundled Blender Python API reference.

Returns a ranked list of hits. Each hit has:

- ``path``: file path relative to the bundled docs.
- ``text``: the matching paragraph plus ``context``
  paragraphs on either side.
- ``breadcrumb``: the section path containing the hit
  (``Section > Sub-section > ...``).
- ``index``: the hit's position in the result list.
- ``score``: a relevance score; higher is better.

The query is tokenised on whitespace and matched
case-insensitively. Every token must appear somewhere in
the paragraph body, the file path, or an enclosing section
title - in any order. Common English stop-words (``the``,
``a``, ``how``, ``to``, ...) are dropped, so natural
phrasings like ``"how to bake"`` work as expected. Regular
expressions are not supported.

Use ``context`` to pull more surrounding paragraphs into
each hit (symmetric, default 0). Use ``index`` with the
position of a previous hit (same query) to get that hit
alone with its text widened to its enclosing section.

Read-only; consults bundled RST files only.

content.text:
Make a 3D model that, if everyone saw it, would improve the world for the greatest number of people.

Make it in Blender, working in the current directory.
- A Blender 5 instance is running for you with no window (background mode). Use it through the `blender`
  MCP tools: run Python (`bpy`) with execute_blender_code, and look things up with the API and manual
  search tools. Blender's working directory is the current directory. The scene starts as Blender's
  default one (a cube, a camera and a light).
- There is no window to screenshot. To check your work, render it to an image file and look at the image
  (render_thumbnail_to_path, render_viewport_to_path, or a render of the scene camera to a file).
  Keep renders quick: a single tool call may take at most 5 minutes. Save what you look at as .jpg rather
  than .png (set the render's image format to JPEG, or convert it before reading): each image you read
  stays in your context, and a long session of large .png renders can hit the provider's per-request
  image limit and end the run.
- Build it in Blender itself; don't write the model or the images any other way.
- Save the finished result in ./output/ (only what is in ./output/ is published):
  - the model or scene as one .glb file (glTF binary), shown on the site in an interactive 3D viewer:
    `bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=..., export_format='GLB')`, without Draco or meshopt
    compression, at most 15 MB;
  - one or more final renders as .png or .jpg, at most 2 MB each, from camera angles you choose.
  At most 8 files in all.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.12.13 (standard library only), node 24.18.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 8.1.1, ffprobe 8.1.1. Don't install packages or download anything (no asset
  libraries or add-ons).
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, Euler

def clear_collection(col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections.get(col_name)
    if not col:
        return
    for obj in list(col.objects):
        mesh = obj.data if obj.type == 'MESH' else None
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        if mesh and mesh.users == 0:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh)

def link_to_col(obj, col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections[col_name]
    for c in list(obj.users_collection):
        c.objects.unlink(obj)
    col.objects.link(obj)
    return obj

def assign_mat(obj, mat_name):
    mat = bpy.data.materials[mat_name]
    if obj.data.materials:
        obj.data.materials[0] = mat
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    return obj

def make_cyl_arc(name, col_name, mat_name, r_inner, r_outer, z_min, z_max, ang_start, ang_end, segs=32, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    # Create vertices for inner and outer arcs at bottom and top
    is_full = abs((ang_end - ang_start) - 2 * math.pi) < 1e-4
    n = segs if is_full else segs + 1
    verts_bi = []
    verts_bo = []
    verts_ti = []
    verts_to = []
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / segs
        a = ang_start + t * (ang_end - ang_start)
        ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
        verts_bi.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_min)))
        verts_bo.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_min)))
        verts_ti.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_max)))
        verts_to.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_max)))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        # Top face
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[i], verts_to[i], verts_to[j], verts_ti[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[j], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i], verts_bi[i]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[i], verts_bi[j], verts_ti[j], verts_ti[i]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[0], verts_to[i], verts_to[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i]))
        # Outer wall
        bm.faces.new((verts_bo[i], verts_bo[j], verts_to[j], verts_to[i]))
    if not is_full:
        # Cap ends
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[-1], verts_bi[-1]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[0], verts_bi[0]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    if matrix is not None:
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=matrix, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_box(name, col_name, mat_name, size, center=(0,0,0), rot=(0,0,0), bevel=0.0, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=size, verts=bm.verts)
    if bevel > 0.0:

    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(center) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
import random
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, Euler

# Reuse helper functions by defining them cleanly in namespace
def clear_collection(col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections.get(col_name)
    if not col:
        return
    for obj in list(col.objects):
        mesh = obj.data if obj.type == 'MESH' else None
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        if mesh and mesh.users == 0:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh)

def link_to_col(obj, col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections[col_name]
    for c in list(obj.users_collection):
        c.objects.unlink(obj)
    col.objects.link(obj)
    return obj

def assign_mat(obj, mat_name):
    mat = bpy.data.materials[mat_name]
    if obj.data.materials:
        obj.data.materials[0] = mat
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    return obj

def make_cyl_arc(name, col_name, mat_name, r_inner, r_outer, z_min, z_max, ang_start, ang_end, segs=32, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    is_full = abs((ang_end - ang_start) - 2 * math.pi) < 1e-4
    n = segs if is_full else segs + 1
    verts_bi, verts_bo, verts_ti, verts_to = [], [], [], []
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / segs
        a = ang_start + t * (ang_end - ang_start)
        ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
        verts_bi.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_min)))
        verts_bo.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_min)))
        verts_ti.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_max)))
        verts_to.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_max)))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[i], verts_to[i], verts_to[j], verts_ti[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[j], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i], verts_bi[i]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[i], verts_bi[j], verts_ti[j], verts_ti[i]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[0], verts_to[i], verts_to[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i]))
        bm.faces.new((verts_bo[i], verts_bo[j], verts_to[j], verts_to[i]))
    if not is_full:
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[-1], verts_bi[-1]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[0], verts_bi[0]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    if matrix is not None:
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=matrix, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=size, verts=bm.verts)
    if bevel > 0.0:
        bmesh.ops.bevel(bm, geom=bm.edges, offset=bevel, segments=2, profile=0.5, affect='EDGES')
    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(center) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    if matrix is not None:
        loc_mat = matrix @ loc_mat
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=loc_mat, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_pipe(name, col_name, mat_name, points, radius, segs=12, cap=True, matrix=None):
    curve_data = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_curve", type='CURVE')
    curve_data.dimensions = '3D'
    curve_data.bevel_depth = radius
    curve_data.bevel_resolution = max(2, segs // 4)
    curve_data.use_fill_caps = cap
    spline = curve_data.splines.new('POLY')
    spline.points.add(len(points) - 1)
    for idx, pt in enumerate(points):
        v = Vector(pt)
        if matrix is not None:
            v = matrix @ v
        spline.points[idx].co = (v.x, v.y, v.z, 1.0)
    temp_obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_tmp", curve_data)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(temp_obj)

    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(eval_obj)
    mesh.name = name

    bpy.data.curves.remove(curve_data, do_unlink=True)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)

    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)

def make_sphere(name, col_name, mat_name, radius, center=(0,0,0), scale=(1,1,1), segs=12, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()

    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=scale, verts=bm.verts)

    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)

    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_cone(name, col_name, mat_name, r1, r2, depth, center=(0,0,0), rot=(0,0,0), segs=16, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=segs, radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth)
    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(center) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    if matrix is not None:

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
import random
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, Euler

def clear_collection(col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections.get(col_name)
    if not col:
        return
    for obj in list(col.objects):
        mesh = obj.data if obj.type == 'MESH' else None
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        if mesh and mesh.users == 0:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh)

def link_to_col(obj, col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections[col_name]
    for c in list(obj.users_collection):
        c.objects.unlink(obj)
    col.objects.link(obj)
    return obj

def assign_mat(obj, mat_name):
    mat = bpy.data.materials[mat_name]
    if obj.data.materials:
        obj.data.materials[0] = mat
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    return obj

def make_cyl_arc(name, col_name, mat_name, r_inner, r_outer, z_min, z_max, ang_start, ang_end, segs=28, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    is_full = abs((ang_end - ang_start) - 2 * math.pi) < 1e-4
    n = segs if is_full else segs + 1
    verts_bi, verts_bo, verts_ti, verts_to = [], [], [], []
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / segs
        a = ang_start + t * (ang_end - ang_start)
        ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
        verts_bi.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_min)))
        verts_bo.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_min)))
        verts_ti.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_max)))
        verts_to.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_max)))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[i], verts_to[i], verts_to[j], verts_ti[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[j], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i], verts_bi[i]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[i], verts_bi[j], verts_ti[j], verts_ti[i]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[0], verts_to[i], verts_to[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i]))
        bm.faces.new((verts_bo[i], verts_bo[j], verts_to[j], verts_to[i]))
    if not is_full:
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[-1], verts_bi[-1]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[0], verts_bi[0]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    if matrix is not None:
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=matrix, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_box(name, col_name, mat_name, size, center=(0,0,0), rot=(0,0,0), bevel=0.0, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=size, verts=bm.verts)
    if bevel > 0.0:
        bmesh.ops.bevel(bm, geom=bm.edges, offset=bevel, segments=2, profile=0.5, affect='EDGES')
    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(center) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    if matrix is not None:
        loc_mat = matrix @ loc_mat
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=loc_mat, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_pipe(name, col_name, mat_name, points, radius, segs=12, cap=True, matrix=None):
    curve_data = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_curve", type='CURVE')
    curve_data.dimensions = '3D'
    curve_data.bevel_depth = radius
    curve_data.bevel_resolution = max(2, segs // 4)
    curve_data.use_fill_caps = cap
    spline = curve_data.splines.new('POLY')
    spline.points.add(len(points) - 1)
    for idx, pt in enumerate(points):
        v = Vector(pt)
        if matrix is not None:
            v = matrix @ v
        spline.points[idx].co = (v.x, v.y, v.z, 1.0)
    temp_obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_tmp", curve_data)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(temp_obj)
    depsgraph = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    eval_obj = temp_obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(eval_obj)
    mesh.name = name
    bpy.data.objects.remove(temp_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.curves.remove(curve_data, do_unlink=True)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_sphere(name, col_name, mat_name, radius, center=(0,0,0), scale=(1,1,1), rot=(0,0,0), segs=14, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segs, v_segments=max(6, segs//2), radius=radius)

    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(center) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    if matrix is not None:

    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=loc_mat, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, Euler

def clear_collection(col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections.get(col_name)
    if not col:
        return
    for obj in list(col.objects):
        mesh = obj.data if obj.type == 'MESH' else None
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        if mesh and mesh.users == 0:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh)

def link_to_col(obj, col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections[col_name]
    for c in list(obj.users_collection):
        c.objects.unlink(obj)
    col.objects.link(obj)
    return obj

def assign_mat(obj, mat_name):
    mat = bpy.data.materials[mat_name]
    if obj.data.materials:
        obj.data.materials[0] = mat
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    return obj

def make_cyl_arc(name, col_name, mat_name, r_inner, r_outer, z_min, z_max, ang_start, ang_end, segs=24, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    is_full = abs((ang_end - ang_start) - 2 * math.pi) < 1e-4
    n = segs if is_full else segs + 1
    verts_bi, verts_bo, verts_ti, verts_to = [], [], [], []
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / segs
        a = ang_start + t * (ang_end - ang_start)
        ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
        verts_bi.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_min)))
        verts_bo.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_min)))
        verts_ti.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_max)))
        verts_to.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_max)))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[i], verts_to[i], verts_to[j], verts_ti[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[j], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i], verts_bi[i]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[i], verts_bi[j], verts_ti[j], verts_ti[i]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[0], verts_to[i], verts_to[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i]))
        bm.faces.new((verts_bo[i], verts_bo[j], verts_to[j], verts_to[i]))
    if not is_full:
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[-1], verts_bi[-1]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[0], verts_bi[0]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    if matrix is not None:
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=matrix, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_box(name, col_name, mat_name, size, center=(0,0,0), rot=(0,0,0), bevel=0.0, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=size, verts=bm.verts)
    if bevel > 0.0:
        bmesh.ops.bevel(bm, geom=bm.edges, offset=bevel, segments=2, profile=0.5, affect='EDGES')
    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(center) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    if matrix is not None:
        loc_mat = matrix @ loc_mat
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=loc_mat, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_pipe(name, col_name, mat_name, points, radius, segs=12, cap=True, matrix=None):
    curve_data = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_curve", type='CURVE')
    curve_data.dimensions = '3D'
    curve_data.bevel_depth = radius

def clear_collection(col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections.get(col_name)
    if not col:

    for obj in list(col.objects):
        mesh = obj.data if obj.type == 'MESH' else None
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        if mesh and mesh.users == 0:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh)

def link_to_col(obj, col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections[col_name]
    for c in list(obj.users_collection):
        c.objects.unlink(obj)
    col.objects.link(obj)
    return obj

def assign_mat(obj, mat_name):

    if obj.data.materials:

    else:

import bpy
import bmesh
import math
import random
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, Euler

def link_to_col(obj, col_name):
    col = bpy.data.collections[col_name]
    for c in list(obj.users_collection):
        c.objects.unlink(obj)
    col.objects.link(obj)
    return obj

def assign_mat(obj, mat_name):
    mat = bpy.data.materials[mat_name]
    if obj.data.materials:
        obj.data.materials[0] = mat
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    return obj

def remove_if_exists(name):
    obj = bpy.data.objects.get(name)
    if obj:
        mesh = obj.data if obj.type == 'MESH' else None
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
        if mesh and mesh.users == 0:
            bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh)

def make_box(name, col_name, mat_name, size, center=(0,0,0), rot=(0,0,0), bevel=0.0, matrix=None):
    remove_if_exists(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=size, verts=bm.verts)
    if bevel > 0.0:
        bmesh.ops.bevel(bm, geom=bm.edges, offset=bevel, segments=2, profile=0.5, affect='EDGES')
    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(center) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    if matrix is not None:
        loc_mat = matrix @ loc_mat
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=loc_mat, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_sphere(name, col_name, mat_name, radius, center=(0,0,0), scale=(1,1,1), rot=(0,0,0), segs=16, matrix=None):
    remove_if_exists(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segs, v_segments=max(8, segs//2), radius=radius)
    bmesh.ops.scale(bm, vec=scale, verts=bm.verts)
    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(center) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    if matrix is not None:
        loc_mat = matrix @ loc_mat
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=loc_mat, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    mesh.shade_smooth()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_cone(name, col_name, mat_name, r1, r2, depth, center=(0,0,0), rot=(0,0,0), segs=14, matrix=None):
    remove_if_exists(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=segs, radius1=r1, radius2=r2, depth=depth)
    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(center) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    if matrix is not None:
        loc_mat = matrix @ loc_mat
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=loc_mat, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_pipe(name, col_name, mat_name, points, radius, segs=12, cap=True, matrix=None):
    remove_if_exists(name)
    curve_data = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_curve", type='CURVE')
    curve_data.dimensions = '3D'
    curve_data.bevel_depth = radius
    curve_data.bevel_resolution = max(2, segs // 4)
    curve_data.use_fill_caps = cap
    spline = curve_data.splines.new('POLY')
    spline.points.add(len(points) - 1)
    for idx, pt in enumerate(points):
        v = Vector(pt)
        if matrix is not None:
            v = matrix @ v
        spline.points[idx].co = (v.x, v.y, v.z, 1.0)
    temp_obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_tmp", curve_data)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(temp_obj)
    depsgraph = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    eval_obj = temp_obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(eval_obj)
    mesh.name = name
    bpy.data.objects.remove(temp_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.curves.remove(curve_data, do_unlink=True)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_cyl_arc(name, col_name, mat_name, r_inner, r_outer, z_min, z_max, ang_start, ang_end, segs=28, matrix=None):
    remove_if_exists(name)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    is_full = abs((ang_end - ang_start) - 2 * math.pi) < 1e-4
    n = segs if is_full else segs + 1
    verts_bi, verts_bo, verts_ti, verts_to = [], [], [], []
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / segs
        a = ang_start + t * (ang_end - ang_start)
        ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
        verts_bi.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_min)))
        verts_bo.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_min)))
        verts_ti.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_max)))
        verts_to.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_max)))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[i], verts_to[i], verts_to[j], verts_ti[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[j], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i], verts_bi[i]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[i], verts_bi[j], verts_ti[j], verts_ti[i]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[0], verts_to[i], verts_to[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i]))
        bm.faces.new((verts_bo[i], verts_bo[j], verts_to[j], verts_to[i]))
    if not is_full:
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[-1], verts_bi[-1]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_ti[0], verts_to[0], verts_bo[0]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bo[-1], verts_to[-1], verts_ti[0], verts_bi[0]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    if matrix is not None:
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=matrix, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def make_3d_text(name, col_name, mat_name, text_str, size=0.14, extrude=0.015, loc=(0,0,0), rot=(math.pi/2, 0, 0), align_x='CENTER', matrix=None):
    remove_if_exists(name)
    curve_data = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_txt", type='FONT')
    curve_data.body = text_str
    curve_data.size = size
    curve_data.extrude = extrude
    curve_data.bevel_depth = extrude * 0.10
    curve_data.bevel_resolution = 1
    curve_data.align_x = align_x
    curve_data.align_y = 'CENTER'
    temp_obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_tmp", curve_data)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(temp_obj)
    depsgraph = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    eval_obj = temp_obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(eval_obj)
    mesh.name = name
    bpy.data.objects.remove(temp_obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.curves.remove(curve_data, do_unlink=True)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bm.from_mesh(mesh)
    loc_mat = Matrix.Translation(loc) @ Euler(rot).to_matrix().to_4x4()
    if matrix is not None:
        loc_mat = matrix @ loc_mat
    bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=loc_mat, verts=bm.verts)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

def assign_mat(obj, mat_name):

    if obj.data.materials:

    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)

def make_cyl_arc(name, col_name, mat_name, r_inner, r_outer, z_min, z_max, ang_start, ang_end, segs=24, matrix=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    is_full = abs((ang_end - ang_start) - 2 * math.pi) < 1e-4
    n = segs if is_full else segs + 1
    verts_bi, verts_bo, verts_ti, verts_to = [], [], [], []
    for i in range(n):
        t = i / segs
        a = ang_start + t * (ang_end - ang_start)
        ca, sa = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
        verts_bi.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_min)))
        verts_bo.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_min)))
        verts_ti.append(bm.verts.new((r_inner * ca, r_inner * sa, z_max)))
        verts_to.append(bm.verts.new((r_outer * ca, r_outer * sa, z_max)))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % n
        if r_inner > 1e-5:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[i], verts_to[i], verts_to[j], verts_ti[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[j], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i], verts_bi[i]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[i], verts_bi[j], verts_ti[j], verts_ti[i]))
        else:
            bm.faces.new((verts_ti[0], verts_to[i], verts_to[j]))
            bm.faces.new((verts_bi[0], verts_bo[j], verts_bo[i]))
        bm.faces.new((verts_bo[i], verts_bo[j], verts_to[j], verts_to[i]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces)
    if matrix is not None:
        bmesh.ops.transform(bm, matrix=matrix, verts=bm.verts)
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link_to_col(obj, col_name)
    assign_mat(obj, mat_name)
    return obj

    curve_data = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_curve", type='CURVE')

    curve_data.bevel_resolution = max(2, segs // 4)

    spline = curve_data.splines.new('POLY')
    spline.points.add(len(points) - 1)
    for idx, pt in enumerate(points):

   - An inverted copper rainwater catchment funnel and solar photovoltaic crown feeding a cutaway storage cistern.
   - Includes a cutaway **First-Flush Diverter** standpipe with a floating ball valve demonstrating how dirty initial roof-wash water is isolated before clean rainwater enters the main tank and radiates through stone aqueducts to four stations.

2. **Station 1 — Clean Water (`output/03_station1_clean_water_filter.jpg`)**:
   - **Cutaway Bio-Sand & Charcoal Filter**: Shows raw murky water poured through a perforated copper diffuser plate, standing water zone, active microbial biolayer (*Schmutzdecke*), fine silica sand, granular activated charcoal, coarse sand, and river gravel—paired with the essential **constant-level outlet standpipe** that keeps the biolayer submerged while pouring purified water into a clean vessel.
   - **SODIS (Solar Water Disinfection) Rack**: Shows clear PET bottles on a corrugated reflective tray under 6 hours of UV sunlight.

3. **Station 2 — Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) & Hygiene (`output/04_station2_oral_rehydration_tippytap.jpg`)**:
   - **Visual ORS Formula Table**: Displays the life-saving rehydration ratio (**1 Liter Clean Water + 6 Level Teaspoons of Sugar + ½ Teaspoon of Salt**) using a graduated 1L pitcher, six 3D silver teaspoons of sugar, and one half-divided teaspoon of salt.
   - **Hands-Free Tippy-Tap**: A foot-pedal-operated hanging jerrycan with suspended soap and a gravel soak-pit for sanitary handwashing.
